about: John Christopher Clark (Chris) is a founding attorney at Clark, Smith & Sizemore, LLC a leading personal injury law firm in Macon, Georgia. Dedicated to seeking justice for the injured, he works to hold commercial trucking companies, nursing homes, insurance companies and other responsible parties accountable for their negligence.

Mr. Clark has received an AV* rating from Martindale-Hubbell. Further, he has received "Best Lawyers in America" designation each year beginning in 2009 and is listed as one of the "Best Lawyers in America" in the field of personal injury. He was chosen as the "Best Lawyer" Personal Injury Macon GA for 2015, 2017, 2020 and 2022. He has been chosen for inclusion in the Georgia Super Lawyers listing each year since 2007. He has been included in the Top 100 Super Lawyers for years 2018-2024. In December 2016, Georgia Trend named him as one of Georgia Trend's Legal Elite - selected by his peers. Mr. Clark received the coveted Traditions in Excellence award in June 2018 for "Excellence and Service to the Public and Georgia State Bar." Mr. Clark was inducted into the American College of Lawyers in September 2019. Mr. Clark received the William A. Bootle Professionalism Award for the Macon Bar Association on May 29, 2020.

Mr. Clark graduated summa cum laude from The Citadel and served as an officer in the United States Army. He received his law degree from Mercer University where he was the Mercer Law Review editor and member of the Brainerd Currie Honor Society. Mr. Clark has served as president of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, president of the Macon Bar Association and president of the Middle Georgia Trial Lawyers Association. He served on the Board of Governors of the State Bar of Georgia from 2011 - 2017. He is a member of the American Association of Justice, the American Board of Trial Advocates, the American and Federal Bar Associations, the State Bar of Georgia and the Macon Georgia Bar.

Chris is a master in the William A. Bootle Inn of Court, an organization of esteemed lawyers in the Macon area. Further, he has been an adjunct professor at Mercer Law School for 24 years, teaching Advanced Legal Writing and Trial practice to third-year students and now teaches Trial Advocacy.

* AV Preeminent and BV Distinguished are certification marks of Reed Elsevier Properties Inc., used in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the confidential opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell ratings fall into two categories: legal ability and general ethical standards.
